title: Zelensky Offers to Halt Drone Strikes on Russian Refineries if Moscow Stops Targeting Ukrainian Energy
detail: President Zelensky publicly offered to cease Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries if Moscow agrees to stop targeting Ukrainian energy infrastructure. The conditional proposal marks a new diplomatic signal, framing reciprocal energy-sector restraint as a potential confidence-building measure amid the broader conflict.

title: Zelenskyy Offers to Hold Elections if Russia Agrees to 60-Day Ceasefire
detail: President Zelenskyy offered to hold Ukrainian elections if Russia agrees to a 60-day ceasefire, marking a significant diplomatic concession from Kyiv amid U.S. pressure from President Trump to replace him. The proposal frames elections as contingent on a meaningful halt to hostilities, reframing the legitimacy debate on Ukraine's own terms.

media.caption: Zelenskyy proposes elections conditioned on a 60-day Russian ceasefire

title: Russia Continues Striking Ukrainian Power Plants Despite Trump's Energy Ceasefire Announcement
detail: Russia continued striking Ukrainian power infrastructure despite U.S. President Trump's announced energy ceasefire proposal, with President Zelensky confirming the attacks are ongoing. The strikes undermine the ceasefire framework promoted by Washington and highlight the gap between diplomatic announcements and ground realities in the conflict.
